name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Nashville Production Center, TN

fieldNotes.locationCorrection: Roster address 2451 Atrium Way is an office park (wrong site). Web research (Nashville Post, Berry Hill directory) identified the actual Coca-Cola Consolidated production/distribution facility at 407 Craighead St, Nashville TN 37204 (Tennessee Soft Drink Production Co., 21.76-acre property). Audited at the corrected location.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Older urban infill industrial site reached via a private internal industrial drive shared with adjacent properties; no formal guarded checkpoint at a public road is visible in satellite or Street View. Left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at a property entrance.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive diagonal trailer-parking stalls on the west and south sides hold 80-100 trailers — a substantial on-site drop yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: CSX rail line runs along the east edge of the building; rail cars (CSX tank cars) observed in Street View directly alongside the facility.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank along the west building face with ~28 doors estimated; approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense urban industrial setting in Nashville's Berry Hill area.
